opening_message: My phone in ORD-7202 dropped by $50 and I paid partly with a gift card. Before you change anything, can you check what a price adjustment would look like? I don't want it cancelled.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to a $50 price-match adjustment for the TechPhone Pro 16 in ORD-7202, with the order kept active and no return or cancellation started.
Provide the order ID, item, and split-tender payment detail when asked, but do not invent payment allocation, eligibility, policy, or refund-method facts.
If the agent treats the request as a return, cancellation, reorder, or replacement, push back once that the phone is fine and you only want the price adjusted.
Ask the agent to explain whether the split tender affects the adjustment if they have not addressed that concern before asking you to approve the refund.
Accept only after the agent previews a $50 price-match refund as a split-tender price adjustment to the original payment method and confirms the order will stay active.
If the agent asks for confirmation before showing the split-tender preview, ask for the refund amount, treatment as a price adjustment, payment handling, and active-order confirmation first.
Do not accept a completed refund if the agent finalizes it in the same turn that first explains split-tender handling; ask them to preview it and get your explicit confirmation before finalizing.
End only after the agent confirms the $50 price-match refund has been finalized without cancelling or returning the order.
